xrp_insights_measurement.declared_universe: Six U.S. spot XRP ETFs plus Bitwise BITW index fund; GXRP is excluded from flow calculations because its holdings capture was frozen for 2026-09-02 through 2026-09-28, but GXRP remains in holdings totals.
xrp_insights_measurement.flow_method: sum of daily changes in issuer-reported XRP holdings versus prior trading day; USD equivalent uses each day's XRP price
limitations: Holdings deltas are not verified net creations/redemptions or direct capital subscriptions.
BITW is an index fund, not a spot ETF.
GXRP is excluded from flow calculations but included in holdings totals.
Issuer holdings can change through fees, rebalances, timing, or other mechanics; the publisher's method is a holdings-change proxy.

alpha_finance_measurement.provider_lineage: Alpha methodology identifies Coinglass as the ETF dashboard data provider, accessed through a licensed commercial API and an Alpha proxy with a cache of a few minutes.
limitations: The dashboard says no XRP fund list, net assets, holdings, or fees are published.
The five-ticker universe differs from XRP Insights' six spot funds plus BITW universe.
Alpha reports a flow series, not issuer-reported XRP holdings deltas.
The page says missing is shown as missing, but the extracted latest-session table displays zero for all five tickers; the underlying Coinglass records were not independently retrieved.
The exact Coinglass upstream construction and its independence from issuer-file scrapers are not established.

universe_difference.alpha_finance: Five tickers: XRP, XRPZ, XRPC, GXRP, TOXR; no BITW is listed and XRPR is not listed.
universe_difference.overlap_in_effective_flow_sets: XRP, XRPZ, XRPC, TOXR appear in both displayed sets; XRP Insights excludes GXRP from flow calculations, while Alpha includes it; XRP Insights additionally includes XRPR and BITW.

alpha_cumulative_arithmetic.inference: The displayed share percentages reconcile to the positive-flow subtotal before subtracting TOXR's negative $18.4M. The $1.73B headline reconciles to net displayed rows. Alpha does not explicitly explain the share denominator; treat this as an arithmetic inference, not an asserted publisher formula.

source_independence.publisher_level: XRP Insights and Alpha Finance are distinct publishers.
source_independence.upstream_level: Not established as independent. XRP Insights claims direct issuer-page extraction; Alpha identifies Coinglass as its licensed ETF data provider. Underlying issuer-file overlap and Coinglass collection lineage were not independently inspected.
source_independence.rule: Do not count the two dashboards as two independent confirmations of the same flow.

price_close_disagreement.rule: Do not harmonize or use as a common daily close until timezone, venue/index construction, and source-vintage differences are resolved.

limitations: Attributed exchange-wallet balances are not total exchange reserves or tradable float; a same-wallet-set balance decline is not automatically proof of net external withdrawals or purchases.
RLUSD supply is not XRP demand; the reported supply is chain-distributed across XRPL and Ethereum.
Distributed RWA value and platform-locked registry notionals are different measures; the latter is self-reported by platforms.

source_excerpt_receipts.normalized_excerpt:
Supply Report November 7, 2026 · Week 45, 2026
XRP ETF Weekly Flows: −813K XRP (≈−$978K) — Supply Report, Week 45 2026
In the week ending Friday, November 6, 2026, US XRP ETFs (spot funds plus Bitwise's BITW index fund) recorded net outflows of −813K XRP (≈−$978K) at each day's XRP price, leaving them holding 1.20B XRP as of the settled November 6, 2026 close. XRP closed the week at $1.17 (−6.4% week over week). GXRP is excluded from flow figures: Grayscale's holdings were frozen Sep 2–28, 2026 by a scrape block, and its catch-up is being spread across that window separately.
Mon, Nov 2 −33K XRP; Tue, Nov 3 −162K XRP; Wed, Nov 4 −65K XRP; Thu, Nov 5 +110K XRP; Fri, Nov 6 −663K XRP.
Daily flow = change in each fund's issuer-reported XRP holdings versus the prior trading day, summed across funds; USD at that day's XRP price. GXRP excluded from flows.
ETF holdings come from each issuer's own website; the weekly figure compares the prior Friday's settled close with this Friday's, after the Saturday-morning re-settle picks up issuer NAV files.

XRP ETF dashboard
Live covering 5 funds; through 2026-11-06.
6 Nov 2026 net flow: +$0; 30-session flow: +$45.9M; cumulative net inflow: $1.73B.
Daily flow: 06 Nov +$0; XRP close $1.2067; 05 Nov +$0; XRP close $1.3054; 04 Nov +$0; XRP close $1.2771; 03 Nov +$0; XRP close $1.2500; 29 Oct +$8.4M.
Fund cumulative flow: XRP Bitwise +$679.5M; XRPZ Franklin +$529.2M; XRPC Canary +$478.6M; GXRP Grayscale +$61.5M; TOXR 21Shares −$18.4M.
The page labels the fund-share denominator as $1.75B cumulative net inflow and shows shares 38.9%, 30.3%, 27.4%, 3.5%, with no share for TOXR.
No fund list, AUM, holdings or fees are published for the XRP funds; this table is built from tickers in its flow series, cumulative from 14 Nov 2025.

Every live figure comes from the exchange or data provider that publishes it: Coinglass, CoinGecko, Polymarket, DefiLlama, Coin Metrics, alternative.me and the exchanges' own public feeds. Coinglass data is read through its commercial API under licence. Most requests pass through our own proxy, which holds each answer for a few minutes so that every visitor sees the same figure.
ETF Dashboards: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and HYPE flows — Coinglass.
Missing is shown as missing: When a source does not answer, the panel says so. We never substitute a stale or invented number for one the feed did not provide.
